title: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
title_zh: OmniCam：基于几何感知姿态标记学习的通用相机轨迹生成方法

paragraphs.en: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam , an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT , containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28–47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.
paragraphs.zh: 相机轨迹控制着视频生成、场景重建和机器人感知中的视角变化。 根据语言描述生成这些轨迹需要同时考虑场景几何结构和目标感知的构图。 我们提出了 OmniCam，这是一种自回归模型，能够根据单张全景图和文本轨迹描述生成相机姿态序列。 其基于几何结构的姿态标记学习结合了三个组件：用于获取全向几何上下文的全景点云编码器；融合绝对旋转和相对平移的标记化方法，并保证四元数符号在时间上的一致性；以及包含明确三维目标锚点的独立几何与语义条件流。 我们还构建了 OmniCaT，其中包含了四种相机行为下的 267,700 条轨迹。 在已报告的 OmniCaT 评估中，与基于 OmniCaT 重新训练的 GenDoP 相比，OmniCam 将轨迹误差降低了 28%–47%，碰撞率降低了 65.8%。 与各项指标的最佳基线模型相比，ATE 和碰撞率的降低幅度分别为 43.0% 和 62.3%。 组件消融实验验证了使用几何结构和目标感知条件流的有效性，而下游实验则检验了相机控制的视频生成和机器人主动感知能力。

paragraphs.en: Camera trajectories serve as a control interface for spatial-intelligence systems, including world models [ 1 ] , video generation [ 13 , 31 ] , and robotics [ 16 , 21 , 2 ] . Specifying a trajectory requires deciding where to move , how to orient , and what to attend to . A prescribed orbit or linear sweep may fail when it intersects scene geometry or loses the intended target. We study generating scene-aware camera trajectories from a panoramic observation and a textual instruction ( ).

paragraphs.en: Recent trajectory generators [ 18 , 7 , 23 , 34 ] motivate three design questions. (i) Scene coverage : perspective RGBD inputs [ 34 ] provide limited angular coverage, while geometry-based planners require explicit spatial representations [ 29 , 30 ] . A panorama provides observations in all directions, although occluded surfaces remain unknown. (ii) Pose serialization : quantization trades precision against token vocabulary size. Quaternion sign ambiguity ( q ≡ − q q\equiv-q ), coordinate scale, and the accumulation of relative increments can affect the resulting learning problem. (iii) Conditioning : geometric free-space information and language-referenced targets serve different roles in planning. Providing dedicated pathways for these cues is a useful architectural choice whose value should be tested empirically. We use geometry-grounded pose token learning to describe a design that connects geometric perception, pose serialization, and target-aware conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的轨迹生成器 [ 18 , 7 , 23 , 34 ] 引发了三个设计问题。 (i) 场景覆盖：视角 RGBD 输入 [ 34 ] 提供的角度覆盖有限，而基于几何的规划器则需要明确的空间表示 [ 29 , 30 ] 。 全景图可以提供全方向的观测信息，尽管被遮挡的表面仍然未知。 (ii) 姿态序列化：量化在精度与词表大小之间进行权衡。 四元数符号的歧义（ q ≡ − q q\equiv-q ）、坐标比例以及相对增量的累积都可能影响最终的學習问题。 (iii) 条件约束：几何自由空间信息与语言参考的目标在规划中扮演着不同的角色。 为这些线索提供专门的通路是一种有用的架构选择，其价值应通过实证检验。 我们使用基于几何的姿态度元学习来描述一种设计，该设计将几何感知、姿态序列化和目标感知条件约束连接起来。

paragraphs.en: OmniCam implements this design with a panoramic point-cloud encoder, hybrid pose tokenization, and a dual-branch conditioning architecture. The point cloud, reconstructed from estimated panoramic depth, provides omnidirectional but partial geometry. Rotations are encoded absolutely with sequential quaternion sign alignment; translations are encoded as increments in a scene-normalized coordinate system. Sign alignment selects consistent representatives of the quaternion double-cover, while quantization remains lossy. Absolute rotations avoid composition of rotation-quantization residuals; relative translations trade a smaller per-step range against accumulated displacement error. We analyze these distinctions in Appendix I and compare the encodings empirically.
paragraphs.zh: OmniCam 通过全景点云编码器、混合姿态标记化和双分支条件架构实现了这一设计。 由估计的全景深度重建的点云提供了全向但部分性的几何信息。 旋转通过序列式四元数符号对齐进行绝对编码；平移则以场景归一化坐标系中的增量形式进行编码。 符号对齐会选择四元数双重覆盖中一致的表示，而量化仍然是有损的。 绝对旋转避免了旋转量化残差的组合；相对平移则用较小的单步范围换取累积位移误差。 我们在附录 I 中分析了这些区别，并对这些编码进行了实证比较。

paragraphs.en: Separate geometric and semantic pathways supply the decoder with structural and target-related features. An attention-derived 3D target centroid is injected through gated cross-attention to provide a spatial anchor for object-directed trajectories. The geometry pathway does not directly receive text; this routing does not imply statistical independence or guarantee the absence of interference after fusion. At inference, a format constraint restricts termination to complete pose-token groups.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的几何路径和语义路径为解码器提供结构特征和目标相关特征。 通过门控交叉注意力注入一个源自注意力的三维目标质心，为面向物体的轨迹提供空间锚点。 几何路径不直接接收文本；这种路由方式并不意味着统计独立性，也不保证融合后不会出现干扰。 在推理阶段，一种格式约束将终止限制在完整的姿态标记组内。

paragraphs.en: Training requires trajectories paired with scene observations and instructions. Existing collections [ 33 , 37 , 24 , 34 ] cover recorded object, scene, and cinematic motions. We construct OmniCaT by recovering geometry and semantic targets from panoramas and synthesizing four behaviors: Target, Surrounding, Reconstruction, and Wandering. The dataset contains 267,700 trajectories with hierarchical descriptions of task, target, and motion. Because supervision is generated on estimated geometry, the learned model may inherit reconstruction errors and planner preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 训练需要与场景观察和指令配对的轨迹。 现有的数据集 [ 33 , 37 , 24 , 34 ] 涵盖了记录的对象、场景和电影级运动。 我们通过从全景图中恢复几何和语义目标，并合成四种行为——目标、周围环境、重建和漫游——来构建 OmniCaT。 该数据集包含 267,700 条轨迹，每条轨迹都对任务、目标和运动进行了分层描述。 由于监督信号是基于估计的几何信息生成的，因此学习到的模型可能会继承重建错误和规划器的偏好。

paragraphs.en: Camera Trajectory Generation. Early approaches rely on optimization-based planning [ 3 , 25 , 11 , 28 ] or learning-based control [ 4 , 10 , 15 , 17 ] . Recent methods integrate camera movement with scene dynamics: CCD [ 18 ] employs a diffusion model with text and keyframe conditioning in character-centric coordinates; E.T. [ 7 ] incorporates character trajectories in global coordinates; Director3D [ 23 ] adopts a DiT-based framework on multi-view data; Hou et al. [ 14 ] predict next-frame motion autoregressively for aerial videography; GenDoP [ 34 ] combines text with RGBD inputs in an autoregressive framework. These methods use different task-specific inputs and trajectory representations. OmniCam studies panoramic point-cloud conditioning and explicit target anchoring, together with the effect of absolute and relative pose serialization in an autoregressive generator.
paragraphs.zh: 相机轨迹生成。 早期的方法依赖于基于优化的规划 [ 3 , 25 , 11 , 28 ] 或基于学习的控制 [ 4 , 10 , 15 , 17 ] 。 近期的方法将相机运动与场景动态相结合：CCD [ 18 ] 采用一种扩散模型，以文本和关键帧为条件，并使用角色为中心的坐标系；E.T. [ 7 ] 将角色轨迹整合到全局坐标系中；Director3D [ 23 ] 在多视角数据上采用基于 DiT 的框架；Hou 等人 [ 14 ] 通过自回归方式预测航拍视频中的下一帧运动；GenDoP [ 34 ] 在自回归框架中将文本与 RGBD 输入相结合。 这些方法使用了不同的任务特定输入和轨迹表示形式。 OmniCam 研究了全景点云条件约束和显式目标锚定，以及绝对和相对姿态序列化在自回归生成器中的影响。

paragraphs.en: Camera Trajectory Datasets. Existing trajectory datasets remain limited in spatial diversity. MVImgNet [ 33 ] , RealEstate10K [ 37 ] , and DL3DV-10K [ 24 ] provide calibrated trajectories but focus on simple motions around stationary objects or within static environments. CCD [ 18 ] and E.T. [ 7 ] offer character-centric tracking data that does not generalize to unconstrained spatial navigation. DataDoP [ 34 ] pairs trajectories with depth maps and text for cinematic applications, yet relies on perspective-view depth covering only a limited field of view. None of these resources simultaneously provides omnidirectional scene geometry, diverse spatial behaviors, and hierarchical textual guidance. OmniCaT fills this gap by grounding trajectory generation in panoramic point-cloud geometry and pairing each trajectory with structured language annotations across four distinct navigation behaviors.

paragraphs.en: Pose Representation Learning. Rotation representation [ 22 , 19 ] has a well-studied impact on learning stability. Zhou et al. [ 38 ] show that quaternions and Euler angles suffer from discontinuities under the topology of SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SO}(3) and propose continuous 6D representations for single-frame rotation regression. Subsequent work considers sequential settings such as human motion prediction [ 8 , 5 ] and robotic manipulation [ 21 , 27 ] . OmniCam uses sequential quaternion sign alignment to reduce inconsistent discrete labels for equivalent rotations, combined with relative translation. This convention does not provide a globally continuous rotation parameterization or an injective finite quantizer.

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , the pipeline consists of three phases. (1) Geometric and semantic grounding : panoramic depth maps are aligned into a global point cloud 𝐏 p ​ a ​ n \mathbf{P}^{pan} [ 32 ] , filtered for outliers, and augmented with semantic landmarks and 3D volumetric masks using language-assisted annotation and segmentation models [ 6 , 26 , 20 ] ; a navigation mesh is then constructed to define the traversable space. (2) Spatial trajectory synthesis : four categories of camera behaviors (Target, Surrounding, Reconstruction, and Wandering) are generated on the navigation mesh, with waypoints and orientations refined via spline and spherical linear interpolation. (3) Rendering and multimodal annotation : a point-based renderer produces video sequences from the planned poses, and a hierarchical annotation scheme derives kinematic motion primitives from camera extrinsics before a vision-language model synthesizes motion-aware textual instructions. Full implementation details, including depth alignment optimization, NavMesh engineering, and trajectory planning heuristics, are provided in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Scope of Synthetic Supervision. The planner uses reconstructed geometry, navigation meshes, and semantic targets to generate feasible examples. OmniCam learns to predict trajectories from a panorama and text without constructing a navigation mesh or running graph search at inference. Downstream evaluation tests the usefulness of this learned mapping. A gap to the planner does not establish freedom from planner bias; evaluation on independently measured geometry and independently specified tasks is needed to assess that limitation.

paragraphs.en: Hybrid Absolute-Relative Pose Encoding. Rotations are encoded as absolute unit quaternions with sequential sign alignment: each frame is aligned with the preceding aligned representative. The deterministic convention and its assumptions are stated in Proposition 2 ; implementation-specific tie handling must agree with that convention. Translations after the initial frame use relative increments, reducing the per-step dynamic range while allowing quantization residuals to accumulate. These components, together with normalized intrinsics, are quantized via uniform binning into per-frame token groups of 9 tokens: 4 rotation, 3 translation, 2 intrinsics ( Figure 3 , right bottom). The token sequence 𝐒 \mathbf{S} is augmented with boundary tokens ( BOS , EOS , PAD ) and projected into a latent space through a learnable codebook.
paragraphs.zh: 混合绝对-相对姿态编码。 旋转被编码为绝对单位四元数，并采用顺序符号对齐：每一帧都与前一个对齐的代表帧进行对齐。 该确定性约定及其假设在命题 2 中有所说明；实现特定的约束处理必须与该约定保持一致。 初始帧之后的平移使用相对增量，从而降低了每一步的动态范围，但允许量化残差逐渐累积。 这些组件与归一化的内参量一起，通过均匀分箱进行量化，形成每帧 9 个标记的标记组：4 个旋转标记、3 个平移标记和 2 个内参量标记（图 3，右下角）。 标记序列 𝐒 \mathbf{S} 被补充了边界标记（BOS、EOS、PAD），并通过一个可学习的码本投影到潜在空间中。

paragraphs.en: Theoretical Motivation. The hybrid scheme balances different reconstruction-error tradeoffs ( Appendix I ). If each decoded rotation has angular quantization error at most ϵ \epsilon , absolute encoding retains this per-frame bound, whereas integrating relative rotations permits a worst-case bound of min ⁡ { π , ( T − 1 ) ​ ϵ } \min\{\pi,(T-1)\epsilon\} when the initial rotation is exact (Proposition 1 ). The value of ϵ \epsilon depends on the component quantizer and decoder normalization. Relative translations can use a smaller displacement range and hence finer local resolution, but their errors can also accumulate. Proposition 2 shows that a specified initial sign rule followed by alignment to the already aligned preceding quaternion removes dependence on the arbitrary quaternion sign when adjacent rotations differ by less than π \pi . This resolves double-cover ambiguity in the supervision; finite quantization remains lossy and many-to-one.
paragraphs.zh: 理论动机。 该混合方案平衡了不同的重建误差权衡（附录 I）。 如果每个解码后的旋转的角量化误差不超过 ϵ \epsilon，绝对编码将保持每帧的这一界限；而相对旋转的积分在初始旋转精确时，其最坏情况界限为 min ⁡ { π , ( T − 1 ) ​ ϵ } \min\{\pi,(T-1)\epsilon\}（命题 1）。 ϵ \epsilon 的值取决于分量量化器和解码器的归一化方式。 相对平移可以使用更小的位移范围，从而实现更精细的局部分辨率，但其误差也可能累积。 命题 2 表明，在相邻旋转的差值小于 π \pi 时，先采用指定的初始符号规则，再与已对齐的前一个四元数进行对齐，即可消除对任意四元数符号的依赖。 这解决了监督过程中的双重覆盖歧义；有限的量化仍然是有损且多对一的。

sents.zh: 如果每个解码后的旋转的角量化误差不超过 ϵ \epsilon，绝对编码将保持每帧的这一界限；而相对旋转的积分在初始旋转精确时，其最坏情况界限为 min ⁡ { π , ( T − 1 ) ​ ϵ } \min\{\pi,(T-1)\epsilon\}（命题 1）。

sents.en: The value of ϵ \epsilon depends on the component quantizer and decoder normalization.
sents.zh: ϵ \epsilon 的值取决于分量量化器和解码器的归一化方式。

sents.en: Relative translations can use a smaller displacement range and hence finer local resolution, but their errors can also accumulate.
sents.zh: 相对平移可以使用更小的位移范围，从而实现更精细的局部分辨率，但其误差也可能累积。

sents.en: Proposition 2 shows that a specified initial sign rule followed by alignment to the already aligned preceding quaternion removes dependence on the arbitrary quaternion sign when adjacent rotations differ by less than π \pi .
sents.zh: 命题 2 表明，在相邻旋转的差值小于 π \pi 时，先采用指定的初始符号规则，再与已对齐的前一个四元数进行对齐，即可消除对任意四元数符号的依赖。

sents.en: This resolves double-cover ambiguity in the supervision; finite quantization remains lossy and many-to-one.
sents.zh: 这解决了监督过程中的双重覆盖歧义；有限的量化仍然是有损且多对一的。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Comparison. On OmniCaT ( Table 1 ), OmniCam reduces ATE, FDE, RPE-R, and RPE-T by 46.6%, 41.1%, 28.0%, and 28.9% relative to retrained GenDoP, respectively. Collision decreases from 30.4% to 10.4% (65.8% relative reduction), and visibility rises from 33.6% to 52.0% (54.8% relative increase). Director3D is the best baseline for ATE and collision; relative to it, the reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%. The scene-bootstrap intervals for OmniCam and GenDoP are reported in Appendix M ; component-specific effects are examined separately below.
paragraphs.zh: 定量比较。 在 OmniCaT（表 1）中，与重新训练的 GenDoP 相比，OmniCam 分别将 ATE、FDE、RPE-R 和 RPE-T 降低了 46.6%、41.1%、28.0% 和 28.9%。 碰撞率从 30.4% 降至 10.4%（相对降低 65.8%），可见性则从 33.6% 提升至 52.0%（相对提升 54.8%）。 Director3D 是 ATE 和碰撞率方面表现最佳的基线模型；与之相比，OmniCam 的降低幅度分别为 43.0% 和 62.3%。 OmniCam 和 GenDoP 的场景引导间隔报告见附录 M；各组件的具体影响将在下文单独分析。

paragraphs.en: Zero-Shot Cross-Dataset Transfer. The reported DataDoP results favor OmniCam over GenDoP trained on DataDoP: ATE 0.925 vs. 1.437, collision 8.9% vs. 28.5%, visibility 64.2% vs. 36.6%, and angle 12.7 ∘ vs. 29.8 ∘ . OmniCam is reported to use no DataDoP fine-tuning. Establishing the extent of transfer requires the input adaptation, data-overlap checks, and metric protocol identified above; these aggregate values alone do not rule out planner bias or differences in available scene information.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本跨数据集迁移。 报告中的 DataDoP 结果显示出 OmniCam 优于在 DataDoP 上训练的 GenDoP：ATE 为 0.925 对比 1.437，碰撞率为 8.9% 对比 28.5%，可见率为 64.2% 对比 36.6%，角度为 12.7° 对比 29.8°。 报告指出 OmniCam 未使用任何 DataDoP 微调。 要确定迁移的程度，需要执行上述已识别的输入适配、数据重叠检查和指标协议；仅凭这些汇总值无法排除规划器偏差或可用场景信息的差异。

paragraphs.en: OmniCam generates camera trajectories from panoramic imagery and language using point-cloud conditioning, hybrid pose serialization, and explicit 3D target anchoring. OmniCaT supplies 267,700 examples across four camera behaviors. The reported comparisons and ablations support these design choices within the evaluated settings, and downstream studies examine their practical use. The representation analysis distinguishes quaternion sign consistency from lossy quantization and identifies the error-accumulation tradeoff of relative encoding. Remaining limitations include estimated and incomplete geometry, planner-derived supervision, static-scene observations, and the need for independently verified evaluation protocols. Future work includes dynamic scenes and closed-loop planning.
paragraphs.zh: OmniCam 通过点云条件约束、混合姿态序列化和显式三维目标锚定，从全景图像和语言中生成相机轨迹。 OmniCaT 提供了涵盖四种相机行为的 267,700 个示例。 报告中的对比实验和消融研究在评估设置内支持了这些设计选择，而下游研究则检验了它们的实际用途。 表示分析区分了四元数符号一致性与有损量化，并识别了相对编码中误差累积的权衡问题。 剩余的局限性包括估计且不完整的几何结构、规划器生成的监督信号、静态场景的观察，以及对独立验证评估协议的需求。 未来的工作包括动态场景和闭环规划。

paragraphs.en: Depth Alignment Optimization. During geometry initialization, the ERP space is subdivided into 42 perspective views (an increase from the default 12) to ensure dense coverage. Depth maps are aligned via a GPU-accelerated Least-Squares Minimal Residual (LSMR) solver. To mitigate artifacts, a grounding pipeline is employed to mask sky regions and to remove depth discontinuities (edge floaters).
paragraphs.zh: 深度对齐优化。 在几何初始化过程中，ERP 空间被细分为 42 个透视视图（高于默认的 12 个），以确保密集覆盖。 深度图通过 GPU 加速的最小二乘最小残差（LSMR）求解器进行对齐。 为减少伪影，采用了一种接地处理流程，以掩码天空区域并消除深度不连续性（边缘浮动点）。

paragraphs.en: NavMesh Engineering. The raw NavMesh generated by the Recast algorithm is configured with cell size 0.1 m, cell height 0.1 m, agent height 0.1 m, agent radius 0.05 m, maximum climb 0.05 m, and maximum slope 30 ∘ . Post-processing consists of: (1) height filtering to remove polygons above a roof threshold; (2) connectivity filtering to retain only the largest connected component; (3) surface snapping through dense ray-casting to correct misaligned vertices that lie below the actual mesh surface; and (4) boundary erosion using KD-Tree accelerated searches to maintain a safety buffer from mesh edges. The resulting navigation graph is constructed by sampling points on the NavMesh surface at 0.05 m spacing (up to 600K nodes), connecting neighbors within 5 × 5\times spacing with a height coherence constraint ( | Δ ​ y | ≤ 0.5 |\Delta y|\leq 0.5 m), and computing shortest paths via Dijkstra from the camera origin.
paragraphs.zh: NavMesh 工程。 由 Recast 算法生成的原始 NavMesh 配置为：单元格大小 0.1 米，单元格高度 0.1 米，智能体高度 0.1 米，智能体半径 0.05 米，最大攀爬高度 0.05 米，以及最大坡度 30°。 后处理包括：(1) 高度过滤，以移除高于屋顶阈值的多边形；(2) 连通性过滤，仅保留最大的连通组件；(3) 通过密集射线投射进行表面贴合，以修正位于实际网格表面下方的错位顶点；以及 (4) 使用 KD-Tree 加速搜索进行边界侵蚀，以在与网格边缘之间保持安全缓冲区。 最终的导航图通过在 NavMesh 表面上以 0.05 米的间距采样点（最多可达 60 万个节点）构建，将间距 5 × 5\times 范围内的相邻点通过高度一致性约束（|Δy| ≤ 0.5 米）连接，并通过迪杰斯特拉算法从相机原点计算最短路径。

paragraphs.en: Scoring Function for Target Paths. For target trajectories, 72 candidate nodes are sampled on a circular boundary at radius r = min ⁡ ( 1.5 × s o ​ b ​ j , d o ​ b ​ j ) r=\min(1.5\times s_{obj},d_{obj}) , where s o ​ b ​ j s_{obj} is the object scale and d o ​ b ​ j d_{obj} is the distance from the camera origin to the target. The optimal node is selected by maximizing a scoring function: S = 5000 ⋅ R l ​ o ​ s − 100 ⋅ Δ ​ θ S=5000\cdot R_{los}-100\cdot\Delta\theta , where R l ​ o ​ s R_{los} is the Line-of-Sight ratio calculated via a 50-point projection test between the candidate position and the target center, and Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta is the angular deviation from the ideal approach direction. Paths are computed via Dijkstra on the NavMesh graph, pruned of backtracking segments, and smoothed with B-spline interpolation (smoothing factor 0.5). All trajectories are resampled to 81 keyframes.
paragraphs.zh: 目标路径的评分函数。 对于目标轨迹，在半径为 r = min(1.5 × s_{obj}, d_{obj}) 的圆形边界上采样 72 个候选节点，其中 s_{obj} 是物体尺度，d_{obj} 是从相机原点到目标的距离。 通过最大化评分函数来选择最优节点：S = 5000 · R_{los} - 100 · Δθ，其中 R_{los} 是通过候选位置与目标中心之间的 50 点投影测试计算出的视线比，Δθ 则是相对于理想接近方向的角偏差。 路径通过 Dijkstra 算法在导航网格图上计算，剪除回溯段，并使用 B-spline 插值（平滑因子为 0.5）进行平滑处理。 所有轨迹均被重采样为 81 个关键帧。

paragraphs.en: OmniCam is trained with the Accelerate framework under bf16 mixed precision. The autoregressive backbone is an OPT-style decoder equipped with FlashAttention-2. The optimizer is AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 , a peak learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , a linear warm-up over the first one percent of the schedule, and cosine annealing for the remaining steps. The gradient is clipped to a global norm of 1.0 1.0 and gradient checkpointing is enabled throughout the decoder. The discrete bin size is B = 256 B=256 , and the maximum translation delta is Δ ​ t max = 0.025 \Delta t_{\max}=0.025 in the normalized coordinate system. The hidden dimension, number of heads, and number of layers are configured as the base variant (hidden dim 1024, 8 heads, 12 layers). Training is performed for approximately one hundred effective epochs on a single node with eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs, with a per-GPU batch size of thirty-two. The localization loss weight is set to λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 . Inference adopts the sample strategy with top- k k truncation at k = 10 k=10 and with the format-constrained decoding procedure described in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: OmniCam 在 bf16 混合精度下使用 Accelerate 框架进行训练。 自回归主干网络是一个采用 OPT 风格的解码器，并配备了 FlashAttention-2。 优化器为 AdamW，其中 β = (0.9, 0.95)，权重衰减为 0.01，峰值学习率为 3 × 10⁻⁵，在训练计划的前 1% 阶段进行线性预热，其余步骤则采用余弦退火。 梯度被钳制到全局范数 1.0，并在整个解码器中启用梯度检查点机制。 离散分箱大小为 B = 256，在归一化坐标系中，最大翻译增量 Δ t_max = 0.025。 隐藏层维度、注意力头数量和层数配置为基础变体（隐藏层维度 1024，8 个头，12 层）。 训练在一个包含八块 NVIDIA H20 GPU 的单节点上进行，持续约一百个有效轮次，每块 GPU 的批量大小为三十二。 定位损失权重设为 λ = 0.5。 推理阶段采用采样策略，在 k = 10 时进行 top-k 截断，并使用第 4.4 节中描述的格式约束解码流程。

paragraphs.en: Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss. The per-token cross-entropy loss is weighted by three multiplicative factors to emphasize the most critical pose channels and learning phases: (1) channel importance weights : rotation channels receive weight 2.0, translation channels 1.5, and intrinsic channels 0.5, reflecting the relative importance of orientation accuracy over positional precision; (2) temporal decay : a linear schedule assigns weight 2.0 to the first frame and decreases to 1.0 at the final frame, prioritizing early trajectory establishment; and (3) curriculum learning mask : during the initial training phase, only early frames contribute to the loss, with later frames gradually enabled as training progresses, preventing the model from attempting to learn long-horizon dynamics before mastering short-horizon patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 加权交叉熵损失。 每个标记的交叉熵损失通过三个乘法因子进行加权，以强调最重要的姿态通道和学习阶段：(1) 通道重要性权重：旋转通道的权重为 2.0，平移通道为 1.5，内禀通道为 0.5，这反映了方向准确性相对于位置精度的相对重要性；(2) 时间衰减：一个线性调度方案将第一帧的权重设为 2.0，并逐渐降低至最后一帧的 1.0，从而优先建立初始轨迹；以及 (3) 课程学习掩码：在初始训练阶段，只有早期帧对损失函数有贡献，随着训练推进，后期帧会逐渐被启用，从而防止模型在掌握短期模式之前尝试学习长期动态。

paragraphs.en: Geometric Branch. Panoramic geometric priors are unprojected into a 3D point cloud, which is then structured into a voxel grid ( 0.02 0.02 m resolution) to enable efficient feature extraction. A LitePT encoder uses positional and surface-normal features to extract per-voxel descriptors via sparse convolution, which are re-projected to yield 𝐅 g ​ e ​ o ∈ ℝ M × C g ​ e ​ o \mathbf{F}_{geo}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times C_{geo}} . This branch has no direct text input. Removing it increases collision rate from 10.4% to 45.8% in Table 2 ; this supports the usefulness of the geometric pathway but does not isolate routing from capacity or input-information changes.
paragraphs.zh: 几何分支。 全景几何先验被投影到三维点云中，随后该点云被组织为体素网格（分辨率 0.02×0.02 米），以实现高效的特征提取。 LitePT 编码器利用位置特征和表面法线特征，通过稀疏卷积提取每个体素的描述符，这些描述符随后被重新投影，得到 𝐅 g ​ e ​ o ∈ ℝ M × C g ​ e ​ o \mathbf{F}_{geo}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times C_{geo}}。 该分支没有直接的文字输入。 移除它会使表 2 中的碰撞率从 10.4% 上升到 45.8%；这支持了几何路径的实用性，但并未将路由与容量或输入信息的变化区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Noisy panoramic geometry / thin structures (geometric branch limitation): in large open environments or near thin structures (fences, poles, railings), the monocular depth estimator [ 32 ] produces noisy or incomplete reconstructions with floating artifacts. These propagate into the LitePT voxel features, causing the geometric branch to either miss collision boundaries or hallucinate obstacles, resulting in physically implausible paths.
paragraphs.zh: 噪声丰富的全景几何/细长结构（几何分支限制）：在大型开放环境或靠近细长结构（围栏、杆子、栏杆）时，单目深度估计器 [32] 会产生带有浮动伪影的噪声丰富或不完整的重建结果。 这些噪声会传播到 LitePT 体素特征中，导致几何分支要么错过碰撞边界，要么虚构出障碍物，从而产生在物理上不合理的路径。

paragraphs.en: Ambiguous target phrases (centroid injection limitation): when multiple semantically similar objects coexist (e.g., “the wooden door” in a hallway with several doors, or “the pillar” among clustered columns), the attention-aggregated centroid may ground to an incorrect instance. Spatial descriptors in the textual guidance partially mitigate this, but the failure persists when such cues are absent or when objects are visually indistinguishable from the panoramic viewpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 模棱两可的目标短语（质心注入限制）：当多个语义相似的对象共存时（例如，走廊中有多个门而需指代“那扇木门”，或成群的柱子中需指代“那根柱子”），通过注意力聚合得到的质心可能会错误地对应到某个具体实例。 文本引导中的空间描述词能在一定程度上缓解这一问题，但当此类提示缺失，或从全景视角看这些对象在视觉上无法区分时，错误仍会发生。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic and interactive scenes (static-scene assumption): the current framework assumes a static panoramic observation. In environments with moving objects (people, vehicles, opening doors), the generated trajectory cannot react to temporal changes, potentially producing paths that collide with dynamic obstacles or fail to track moving targets. Extending OmniCam to video-conditioned or closed-loop settings is an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 动态与交互式场景（静态场景假设）：当前框架假设了静态的全景观察。 在存在移动物体（人物、车辆、开启的门）的环境中，生成的轨迹无法对时间上的变化做出反应，可能导致路径与动态障碍物发生碰撞，或无法跟踪移动目标。 将 OmniCam 扩展到以视频为条件或闭环的设置中，是未来工作的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: Reflective/transparent surfaces (semantic branch limitation): glass walls and mirrors produce ambiguous visual features in the vision encoder, leading to unreliable target-aware conditioning and erratic trajectory orientation near such surfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 反射性/透明表面（语义分支限制）：玻璃墙和镜子会在视觉编码器中产生模糊的视觉特征，导致在这些表面附近的目标感知条件不可靠，且轨迹方向出现异常。

paragraphs.en: Occluded targets (centroid injection limitation): when the target object is heavily occluded, the cross-attention weights spread to visible but irrelevant regions, causing the estimated centroid to shift away from the true target location.
paragraphs.zh: 被遮挡的目标（质心注入限制）：当目标物体被严重遮挡时，交叉注意力权重会扩散到可见但无关的区域，导致估计的质心偏离真实目标位置。

paragraphs.en: Broader Impacts. Scene-aware camera planning may assist content creation and robotic perception. Camera deployment can also raise privacy or surveillance concerns, and generated video may be used misleadingly. Dataset release requires source-specific permission and license review, and physical deployment requires validation against the actual environment.

paragraphs.en: Generated videos are evaluated with five reported measures. CLIP-Score averages the cosine similarity between CLIP ViT-B/32 image and scene-description embeddings over 10 sampled frames. Consecutive-frame SSIM measures adjacent-frame similarity and is sensitive to motion magnitude; it is not a motion-compensated temporal-consistency metric. Aesthetic proxy combines CLIP embedding magnitude and inter-frame embedding coherence on a reported 0–10 scale. Its formula and normalization require verification. Known-region Fidelity compares generated frames with point-cloud renderings in observed regions using SSIM, so it uses a rendering reference. Generation Coverage is the mean unknown-region mask ratio, a descriptor of synthesis difficulty rather than an accuracy metric.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的视频通过五项已报告的指标进行评估。 CLIP-Score 对 CLIP ViT-B/32 图像嵌入与场景描述嵌入在 10 个采样帧上的余弦相似度取平均值。 连续帧 SSIM 衡量相邻帧的相似性，并对运动幅度敏感；它并非一种经过运动补偿的时间一致性指标。 美学代理指标结合 CLIP 嵌入的幅值与帧间嵌入的一致性，并以 0–10 的已报告量表进行评分。 其公式和归一化方式需要验证。 已知区域保真度使用 SSIM 将生成帧与观测区域中的点云渲染结果进行比较，因此它使用了一个渲染参考。 生成覆盖率为未知区域掩码的平均比率，是合成难度的描述符，而非准确性指标。

sents.zh: 连续帧 SSIM 衡量相邻帧的相似性，并对运动幅度敏感；它并非一种经过运动补偿的时间一致性指标。

sents.en: Aesthetic proxy combines CLIP embedding magnitude and inter-frame embedding coherence on a reported 0–10 scale.
sents.zh: 美学代理指标结合 CLIP 嵌入的幅值与帧间嵌入的一致性，并以 0–10 的已报告量表进行评分。

sents.en: Its formula and normalization require verification.
sents.zh: 其公式和归一化方式需要验证。

sents.en: Known-region Fidelity compares generated frames with point-cloud renderings in observed regions using SSIM, so it uses a rendering reference.
sents.zh: 已知区域保真度使用 SSIM 将生成帧与观测区域中的点云渲染结果进行比较，因此它使用了一个渲染参考。

sents.en: Generation Coverage is the mean unknown-region mask ratio, a descriptor of synthesis difficulty rather than an accuracy metric.
sents.zh: 生成覆盖率为未知区域掩码的平均比率，是合成难度的描述符，而非准确性指标。

paragraphs.en: Relative to GenDoP, the reported OmniCam results improve CLIP score by 14.1%, consecutive-frame SSIM by 15.4%, the aesthetic proxy by 18.0%, and known-region fidelity by 9.2%. The unknown-region mask ratio is 38.5% vs. 35.8%. These results describe outputs of the trajectory-plus-video pipeline; they do not isolate framing, path length, speed, or geometric consistency as the cause of improvement. Quantitative reconstruction accuracy and completeness are not evaluated in this table.
paragraphs.zh: 与 GenDoP 相比，报道的 OmniCam 结果将 CLIP 分数提升了 14.1%，连续帧 SSIM 提升了 15.4%，美学代理指标提升了 18.0%，已知区域保真度提升了 9.2%。 未知区域掩码比例为 38.5%，而 GenDoP 为 35.8%。 这些结果描述了轨迹加视频流程的输出；它们并未将构图、路径长度、速度或几何一致性单独确定为改进的原因。 本表未对重建的定量准确性和完整性进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Robotic Manipulation (Active Perception). OmniCam is evaluated as an active-perception module for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 16 ] , generating camera trajectories to improve target observations. A trial succeeds when the designated object is grasped within the time limit. The original record describes 200 episodes across 50 tabletop scenes, with reported success rates of 72.5% for OmniCam, 48.0% for GenDoP, and 56.3% for a fixed camera. The fixed-camera percentage is incompatible with a single pooled denominator of 200 binary trials; its aggregation remains unresolved.

paragraphs.en: Table 12 reports 95% confidence intervals from 1,000 bootstrap resamples of OmniCaT evaluation scenes for OmniCam and retrained GenDoP. The listed intervals do not overlap.
